description: This Java class, SaxParserFactory, provides a factory method for obtaining a configured SAXParser instance with specific settings, and contains a main method demonstrating how to use it to parse an XML file.

classes.name: SaxParserFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing a method to create and configure SAXParser instances with specific settings, and a main method demonstrating its usage.

methods.name: getSaxParser
methods.description: Returns a new SAXParser instance configured to be namespace unaware, validating, and XInclude unaware.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Demonstrates usage of getSaxParser to parse an XML file '/ecu_defs.xml' with a default handler, printing validation status and buffer size.
